## Names

<a id="read_joystick_port1"></a>
### [`read_joystick_port1`](../../../../src/input/joystick.asm#L6) `$6B5D`

*routine*

Returns the direction bits of joystick port 1 in A (CIA 1 port B AND $0f, a bit is 0 when pressed).

- **Called from:** [`handle_rockford`](../rockford/movement.md#handle_rockford) [`$72A8`](../../../../src/rockford/movement.asm#L178), [`options_read_joystick`](../title/options.md#options_read_joystick) [`$84A2`](../../../../src/title/options.asm#L41), [`options_read_joystick`](../title/options.md#options_read_joystick) [`$84CE`](../../../../src/title/options.asm#L65), [`options_read_joystick`](../title/options.md#options_read_joystick) [`$84DF`](../../../../src/title/options.asm#L74)
- **Reads:** [`CIAPRB`](../../memory-map.md#CIAPRB)

<a id="read_joystick_port2"></a>
### [`read_joystick_port2`](../../../../src/input/joystick.asm#L11) `$6B63`

*routine*

Returns the direction bits of joystick port 2 in A. Rockford uses it for player 2 when the game has two joysticks.

- **Called from:** [`handle_rockford`](../rockford/movement.md#handle_rockford) [`$72A3`](../../../../src/rockford/movement.asm#L175)
- **Reads:** [`CIAPRA`](../../memory-map.md#CIAPRA)

<a id="read_fire_current_player"></a>
### [`read_fire_current_player`](../../../../src/input/joystick.asm#L16) `$6B69`

*routine*

Reads the fire button of the current player into fire_button ($00 when pressed). Z is set when pressed.

- **Called from:** [`try_move_rockford`](../rockford/movement.md#try_move_rockford) [`$7218`](../../../../src/rockford/movement.asm#L87), [`check_restart_fire`](../engine/cave_scan.md#check_restart_fire) [`$7DC3`](../../../../src/engine/cave_scan.asm#L26)
- **Reads:** [`current_player`](../../memory-map.md#current_player)

<a id="read_fire_of_player"></a>
### [`read_fire_of_player`](../../../../src/input/joystick.asm#L19) `$6B6B`

*routine*

Reads the fire button of the player in A (0 or 1): port 2 for player 2 with two joysticks, else port 1.

- **Called from:** [`wait_next_player_fire`](../status/end_of_life.md#wait_next_player_fire) [`$7FBE`](../../../../src/status/end_of_life.asm#L29)

- **Reads:** [`two_joysticks`](../../memory-map.md#two_joysticks), [`CIAPRA`](../../memory-map.md#CIAPRA)
